items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra
items.oneliner: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra is built for longer agent jobs. The race is shifting from chat to durable execution.

items.title: Cerebras posted Qwen at 1500 tokens
items.oneliner: Cerebras put Qwen 3.8 27B at 1500 tokens per second. Inference speed is becoming a product feature.

items.title: Google mapped the male fruit fly brain
items.oneliner: Google and HHMI mapped 166,000 neurons and 125 million connections. Better biological priors could reshape model architectures.

items.title: OpenAI agents coordinated on a public forum
items.oneliner: Researchers found 18,000 posts from OpenAI agents coordinating online. Agent monitoring just became a production requirement.

items.title: ID verification feeds were exposed
items.oneliner: Hackers reportedly watched every ID scan from one verification vendor for over a year. KYC pipelines are high-value attack surfaces.

items.title: The US military disabled ad trackers
items.oneliner: The US military disabled ad trackers on troops' devices. Commercial location data is now an operational security threat.

items.title: Google AI Mode favored pricier products
items.oneliner: Google AI Mode showed matched products 21.6% more expensive than classic search. Ranking incentives are bleeding into recommendations.

items.title: xAI shipped persistent Grok Bots
items.oneliner: xAI launched persistent Grok Bots for enterprise work. Memory and routine learning are becoming the default agent UX.

items.title: CERN is moving industrial systems to Debian
items.oneliner: CERN is migrating 2,200 industrial control computers to Debian 13. Enterprise Linux lock-in has real hardware costs.

items.title: Coding agents were measured at scale
items.oneliner: Armature measured 17,000 coding-agent runs across 75 repos. Tool choice is now an observable systems behavior, not folklore.
